stem:
Vivek must make an exact copy of $\angle PQR$ at a new vertex $S$ on a fresh ray.

Which construction copies the angle?

options.text: Name the new vertex $S$ as the copied angle, and transfer no arc or chord from $\angle PQR$.
Draw any arc at $S$ only, and skip matching the arc radius and the chord used on $\angle PQR$.
From $Q$ and from $S$ draw arcs of the same radius; then transfer the chord between the arc hits on $\angle PQR$ onto the new arc, and join that mark to $S$.
Say the finished equal angle at $S$ is what produces the matching arc radius and chord, instead of transferring those lengths from $\angle PQR$.

teacher.key_rationale: An exact copy keeps the same vertex-to-arc radius and the same chord between arc hits, transferred from the source angle onto the new ray.
